name: HealthVerse Post-Discharge Early Warning Ruleset
description: Rule-based decision support logic for post-discharge continuous monitoring in rural and low-connectivity environments
disclaimer: Decision-support and early-warning tool only. Does not diagnose or prescribe. High and critical alerts require clinician review.

rules.explanation: Oxygen saturation dropped below 92%, indicating severe respiratory compromise.
rules.action: Immediate emergency care required. Call 108 or transfer to nearest emergency center.

rules.explanation: Oxygen saturation is in the warning range (92-94%), requiring urgent clinician evaluation.
rules.action: Contact attending clinician immediately for respiratory assessment.

rules.explanation: Body temperature exceeds 38.5°C, presenting risk of surgical site infection, sepsis, or acute complication.
rules.action: Urgent clinician evaluation needed. Check wound site and hydration.

rules.explanation: Post-discharge chest pain is a critical red flag for acute cardiovascular or pulmonary event.
rules.action: Call 108 emergency service or proceed to nearest ICU/emergency immediately.

rules.explanation: Patient is experiencing moderate-to-severe shortness of breath at rest or minimal exertion.
rules.action: Urgent medical attention needed immediately. Position upright and call emergency services.

rules.explanation: Active wound bleeding, hematemesis, or rectal bleeding observed.
rules.action: Immediate clinician review. Apply direct gentle pressure if external.

rules.redFlag: Purulent wound discharge or site breakdown
rules.explanation: Discharge, spreading redness, or breakdown at surgical wound site.
rules.action: Clinician review required within 2-4 hours to evaluate wound infection.

rules.redFlag: Sudden confusion, altered mental status, or extreme drowsiness
rules.explanation: Acute changes in mental clarity can signal stroke, sepsis, or metabolic derangement.
rules.action: Emergency medical review. Call 108 or hospital emergency.

rules.redFlag: Persistent vomiting / unable to retain oral fluids or medicines
rules.explanation: Risk of severe dehydration and failure of oral medications.
rules.action: Contact clinician for IV fluid/antiemetic assessment.

rules.redFlag: Reduced urine output (< 500ml/day or no urination for > 12 hours)
rules.explanation: Indicates acute kidney injury, severe volume depletion, or urinary obstruction.
Critically elevated blood pressure carries immediate cardiovascular and cerebrovascular risk.
Low blood pressure indicates possible sepsis, internal bleeding, or dehydration.
rules.action: Notify clinician immediately; keep patient recumbent.

rules.redFlag: Abnormal heart rate (Pulse > 125 bpm or < 48 bpm)
3 or more consecutive missed doses of critical medication
rules.explanation: Discontinuation of critical medications (e.g. anticoagulants, cardiac, insulin) poses acute relapse risk.
rules.action: Immediate clinician & CHW follow-up outreach required.

rules.redFlag: 2 consecutive missed doses of critical medication
rules.explanation: Consecutive missed doses of critical medication detected.
rules.action: CHW / Caregiver prompt to assist patient with medication adherence.

rules.explanation: Patient is experiencing 2 or more symptoms at moderate or higher intensity.
rules.action: Schedule a routine tele-check or in-person follow-up within 24-48 hours.
